## Question and short answer

Which spectral reference law calibrates global and nested DWLS policy tests
across realistic textbook models? No calibration evidence is available yet.
The population builder stopped before smoke: imposing equal standardized Risk
paths in the Worland model made its proposed latent-response correlation matrix
indefinite. The study requires a population-design decision before it can proceed.

## Evidence and caveats

The original Worland correlation is positive definite (minimum eigenvalue
0.290773). Its standardized Risk paths to Achieve and Adjust are −1.592146
and −2.310772. Replacing both by their mean and adjusting observed residual
diagonals to retain unit response variances produces minimum eigenvalues
−0.327866 for the residual covariance and −0.216976 for the response
correlation. This invalid construction is refused, as registered; no population
repair or simulation was performed. Six earlier population constructions passed
the validity checks, but the builder publishes nothing until all eight pass.
The MDD construction has not yet been checked.

The proposal awaiting a decision is to replace the Worland path equality by
equality of its second and third Cognitive loadings, preserving its published
structural paths. That alternative has not been built or validated. A dated
criteria amendment must precede any smoke if the design changes.

## Reproduce

From the repository root:

```sh
Rscript experiments/decisions/07-dwls-reference-law/scripts/build_populations.R --help
Rscript experiments/decisions/07-dwls-reference-law/scripts/build_populations.R \
  --corpus /home/jonas/Files/research/magmaan/external/textbook-corpus
```

The second command currently exits nonzero at the registered invalid-population
gate. Runner implementation, smoke, pilot, fan-out validation and pricing remain
outstanding. Production remains unlaunched; simbox is unavailable.
